g.text: LFM2.5-230M: from the first Vulkan forward to searched inference

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #727a85

g.text: 128-token prompt / prefix; 64 forced decode tokens; completed host F32 logits. Each encoding has its own immutable checkpoint.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #727a85

g.text: H0 First Vulkan · H1 Register tiles · H2 Microtiles/subgroups · H3 Native encoding · H4 Q4 dots/residual

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #727a85

g.text: H5 Prefill search · H6 Decode search · H7 Ordered readback · H8 Adaptive 32/128-row prefill

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #727a85

g.text: Bars span sample min/max, not confidence intervals. H0–H4: five samples; H5–H8: seven. Native uses chunk 32 before H8; the separate diamond uses chunk 128.
